summary: Milestone 5 adds free members, Stripe test-mode paid tiers, offers, content gates, first-party metrics, and a staff member CRM on Cloudron beta.
detailed_changes: Public registration creates a free membership row and links the verified email to the existing mailing contact without auto-subscribe or bypassing double opt-in.
Stripe test-mode monthly/yearly plans, Checkout, Billing Portal, and signed webhooks mark paying status; staff can manage plans and promotional offers with redemption audit.
Posts and pages support public, members, and paid visibility with gated HTML omission; first-party content views and mail open/click tokens feed a staff Metrics dashboard and Members CRM.
affected_areas: Page or route: /account, /staff/members, /staff/metrics, /staff/offers, /staff/membership-plans, Stripe webhook, article/page gates
User groups affected: public members; paying members (test mode); staff
Public impact: member portal, gated content CTAs, cookie notice for first-party metrics
Internal impact: test-mode billing only; no production cutover, live Stripe charges, Ghost retirement, or new live-send authorization
